scope: Build causal, per-episode observations suitable for repeated frozen-policy queries. Offline validation only. Separate replay of the official preprocessing and of visibility from the original MuJoCo states. No optimizer, inference, hardware, integration or student task result.
population: All original 16 target returns, six TRAIN episodes, all ten body images and the current right wrist per query. Evaluate every source O0 primary observation and the complete two source episode state tracks for contextual proprioception statistics. Do not select windows by visibility, task success or subsequent output.
operation: Accept only the registered two RGB views, current calibrated robot geometry and actual bilateral finger readings, current native tick and the episode's fixed natural-language instruction. Recompute current right state without the teacher or future observations. Preserve reset body image, and exact eight 1 s histories and current body; reproduce missing-left visual and state convention. Test reset, clock ordering, no-lookahead and missing history. Compare model-bound input bytes, prompt and side identity to the existing input and calls.
visual_check: On the frozen original scene, render only stored states without stepping. Match both actual camera colors to captured bytes at every unique required camera state. Use native segmentation geometry IDs to measure visible target and competing cube pixels in the body history and current wrist. Report zero vs nonzero, pixel counts and bounding extent, not recognition. Geometry solely for scoring.
state_and_language: Use pinned upstream config and normalization assets to inspect what is passed to the network, including prompt tokenization/truncation and state in source model coordinates. Report right state relative to checkpoint per-coordinate quantiles and to both available source demonstrations. Include exact task text and target color match across all windows. Quantiles indicate marginal tails, not proof of causal domain shift. No correction selected using task scores.
